Subject: Clarify who owns spend + security steps for GridWorks pilot

Hi Priyanka / Amit — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment moving into a short pilot: 

What we discussed
- 30-day pilot of Redwood Inference for your recommendation engine workload (expected 300k tokens/day peak).
- Success criteria: sub-200ms p90 latency, cost < $0.0006/token, and stable output quality on the provided eval set.

Open items I need from you to move faster
1) Who owns the budget / signs the PO for this pilot? (economic/budget owner name + email)
2) Who will own the security/compliance intake (SOC2 evidence, network/VPC requirements)?
3) Procurement timeline — any PO/invoice cadence or internal legal redlines we should expect?

Immediate next steps (proposed)
- Can you confirm the budget owner by EOD Wed?
- I’ll send our procurement checklist + a short SOC2 questionnaire (attached) for your security team to review.
- If Amit is the budget owner, suggested 30-min intro with him and procurement this week to confirm scope and billing.

Attachments: SOC2-questionnaire.xlsx (attached)

Happy to adapt the timeline — tagging Marcus and Laura on pricing and procurement questions.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0128

Neha — thanks for the clear recap. Short answers: 

- Budget/economic owner: Amit Kapoor, CFO (amit.kapoor@gridworks.io). He signs pilots up to $50k.
- Security intake: That’s handled by our IT Security team (cc'd is our intake alias it-security@gridworks.io; I'll introduce the team if you send the questionnaire and any SOC2 artifacts).
- Procurement notes: We usually request a standard SOW + invoice with PO number. Procurement estimates 3-6 business days once legal and finance have the SOW and pricing.

Proposed timeline: 
- Wed: we confirm the budget owner with Amit (he's traveling but can carve out 20 minutes).
- Thu: security team will review the SOC2 questionnaire; they prefer a shared Drive link for evidence.

Please send the procurement checklist and proposal (pricing) and I’ll loop in procurement and Amit.

Thanks,
Priyanka Rao
Head of Product Ops, GridWorks
priya@gridworks.io | +1 212-555-0199
